scenarios.name: Global Trade De-escalation
scenarios.description: Resolution of major trade disputes and normalization of relations with key trading partners, reducing tariffs and supply chain disruptions.

impacts.explanation: Reduced tariffs and stable supply chains would improve trade deficit, boosting GDP and consumer confidence.
Lower import costs could ease inflationary pressures.

scenarios.reasoning: Probabilistic thinking suggests ~20% chance based on historical resolution rates of trade conflicts. Outside view favors gradual de-escalation given ongoing diplomatic efforts.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Persistent Inflationary Pressures
scenarios.description: Sustained high inflation due to energy prices, wage growth, or supply chain bottlenecks.

impacts.explanation: Higher energy costs could reignite inflation, increasing real interest rates.
Central bank may raise rates to combat inflation.

scenarios.reasoning: Underreacting to past inflation trends and stabilizing energy markets reduces this probability. Cognitive debiasing avoids overconfidence in rate cuts.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation in Europe
scenarios.description: Escalation of conflicts in Eastern Europe leading to increased military spending and uncertainty.

impacts.explanation: Disrupted supply chains from material shortages would slow manufacturing.
Labor market disruptions from defense-related job cuts.

scenarios.reasoning: 25% chance based on correlation of recent events with Ukraine/Germany relations. Clashing causal forces (military spending vs. economic stability) require probabilistic weighting.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Tech-Driven Productivity Surge
scenarios.description: AI and automation advancements boost industrial output and wages without triggering inflation.

impacts.explanation: Automation efficiency could offset labor shortages.

scenarios.reasoning: Outside view suggests moderate probability from historical tech adoption patterns. Granular analysis shows tech spending trends support this scenario.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Federal Debt Overhang Effects
scenarios.description: Rising interest on federal debt crowds out private investment and increases government borrowing costs.

impacts.explanation: Higher yields as debt servicing costs consume fiscal space.
Fed may raise rates to manage debt-related inflation risks.

scenarios.reasoning: Probabilistic thinking assigns 20% based on historical debt dynamics. Striking balance avoids overreacting to current deficit levels.

scenarios.name: Energy Price Collapse
scenarios.description: Sudden drop in oil/gas prices due to increased supply or reduced demand.

impacts.explanation: Lower energy costs reduce overall CPI.
Cheaper construction materials boost residential building.

scenarios.reasoning: 10% probability due to unpredictable energy markets. Continuous updating would adjust this if OPEC+ policies shift.
tetlockCommandments: Triage - Focus on questions where careful thinking pays off

methodology: Applied probabilistic weighting of scenarios using Tetlock's pillars (probabilistic thinking, outside view) and commandments (triage, error-balancing). Impact magnitudes derived from scenario analysis.
geopoliticalSummary: Elevated tensions possible in Eastern Europe and Middle East, with 25% probability of conflict escalation impacting trade and industry.
geoeconomicSummary: Trade deficits and debt dynamics remain key risks, though 20% chance of stabilization through diplomatic/economic measures.
currentEventsSummary: Mixed signals from strong housing starts vs. flat payrolls. Inflation moderating slightly but energy prices volatile.
